In the game's art pixels, to scale. From Core/Lobby/DenMap.cs, BayMap.cs and Ui/Den/DenRoom.cs; the design is docs/design/lobby.md.
The outer rooms are their own screens, each one behind a door; the badges mark the two ends of each way in. The bay has no ladder: the lift is the only way up to the top deck.
